verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents REST APIs, a browser-testable API reference, an embedded iframe, and llms.txt/AI-assistant docs ingestion, but never names an official Crossmint SDK package. The x402 and MPP guides use third-party clients (@x402/core, mppx), which do not count as official Crossmint SDKs. Without first-party SDK evidence, this applicable story cannot be credited.
